top_signals.title: Todd Boehly’s Insurer Vows to Restructure Collateral Loans
top_signals.summary: Security Benefit Life Insurance Co., the insurer controlled by Wall Street veteran Todd Boehly, said it will restructure its $14 billion stockpile of collateral loans after such assets drew scrutiny from regulators. Sridhar Natarajan has more on "Bloomberg The Open." (Source: Bloomberg)
